description: Search rooms, shared apartments, sublets and apartments for rent on Roomly, in New York City (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island) and Israel (Tel Aviv, Jerusalem, Haifa and more). Use it when someone wants to rent a room, find a roommate, a sublet or an apartment. Every result has a url; give it to the user so they can contact the owner on Roomly. search_url opens the same search on the website.

listing_type.description: A room in a shared apartment, or a whole apartment.

location.description: City, borough or New York neighborhood, e.g. "New York", "Brooklyn", "Bushwick", "Hell's Kitchen", "Tel Aviv", "תל אביב". Empty = everywhere.

max_price.description: Maximum monthly price in the local currency (USD in New York, ILS in Israel).

min_price.description: Minimum monthly price in the local currency.

move_out.description: Move-out date for a sublet, YYYY-MM-DD.

no_broker_fee.description: Only listings without a broker fee.

offset.description: For the next page, pass next_offset from the last result.

query.description: Free text matched against the title, city and street.

rooms.description: Israel only: room counts to include, e.g. [2, 3]. 6 means 6 or more.

term.description: Long-term rental or sublet / short stay.

name: search_listings
title: Search Roomly listings
